noun.definition: A stone or concrete edging to a pavement or raised path.
noun.example: The car's front wheel hit the kerb.

verb.definition: To furnish with a kerb (rarely used in this sense; usually refers to the physical construction).
verb.example: The council decided to kerb the entire length of the new road.

usage_examples: She stepped off the kerb into the street.
The cyclist swerved to avoid hitting the high kerb.
